subject: Regional onboarding addendum — hot-standby APAC + EU data residency clarifications
messages:
From: Eliot Shaw <eliot@neurohealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Qureshi <sana.qureshi@neurohealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & region questions

Diego —

Thanks for the call today. A couple of follow-ups as we start budgeting for next year: NeuroHealth is committed to moving our PHI-adjacent workloads into an EU-only region for our EU customers, but we still need APAC capacity on standby for latency-sensitive failover and burst traffic when Singapore goes hot.

High level asks:
- Clarify whether we can maintain EU residency for primary data while allowing encrypted inference bursts to APAC (logs and telemetry must remain in EU).
- Rough estimate for a 2x burst capacity for up to 10% of monthly traffic during APAC early-morning peaks.
- Confirm any contract language you need to add around cross-region failover and data boundary clauses.

Looping in Legal (legal@neurohealth.com) to track compliance items. Can you put together a short addendum we can review by mid-November?

— Eliot
Eliot Shaw
Director, Platform Ops
NeuroHealth Inc
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Shaw <eliot@neurohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & region questions

Eliot —

Thanks, this is clear and aligned with what we discussed. I attached a draft addendum that: 1) pins NeuroHealth's primary residency to our EU cluster, 2) defines a hot-standby APAC pool for burst/failover (encrypted in-transit, ephemeral KV caches in APAC, logs retained in EU), and 3) proposes a fixed pricing uplift for standby capacity.

Quick notes:
- Standby pool sizing: attached spreadsheet has three options (small/medium/large) — we recommend starting medium if you expect peak bursts at ~10% traffic.
- Data boundary: we will route inference payloads to APAC when you opt into standby; full request/response traces and logs will be routed back and stored in the EU tenancy only.
- Rollout timeline: EU cutover + residency QA in 6 weeks after signature, APAC standby available in 8–10 weeks depending on capacity reservation.

I copied Monica for the SRE/ops runbook and Ben for commercial/pricing. If this looks good I can turn the draft into a formal addendum for your legal to redline.

Attachments: redwood-residency-addendum-v1.pdf, capacity-estimate-NeuroHealth-2026.xlsx

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sana Qureshi <sana.qureshi@neurohealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Eliot Shaw <eliot@neurohealth.com>, legal@neurohealth.com
Date: 2026-11-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & region questions

Diego —

Appreciate the draft. A few comments from our side after an initial pass and an offline chat with security:
- We need a clearer definition of telemetry/trace retention: please specify retention windows for request logs vs anonymized metrics.
- For the APAC standby, can you guarantee that any persisted cache in APAC is ephemeral and will be flushed within X hours of the event? We need that in writing.
- Pricing: your three options are helpful. Can you model an 'annual commitment' discount level (12-month reserve) vs month-to-month standby?

Legal asked for a version with inline redlines they can edit. Can you send a Word/DocuSign-friendly copy?

— Sana
Sana Qureshi
VP, Security & Compliance
NeuroHealth Inc
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sana Qureshi <sana.qureshi@neurohealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T13:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & region questions

Hi Sana / team —

Thanks for the notes. Technical clarifications:
- Retention windows: request/response logs (full traces) will be retained in EU for 90 days by default; anonymized aggregated metrics can be retained longer (configurable up to 365 days). We can shorten the retention window to 30 days for request/response logs if that helps your compliance posture — happy to add that option to the addendum.
- Ephemeral caches: APAC nodes will only hold KV caches for active sessions. We will enforce an automated TTL flush and a post-event flush hook that clears session caches within 4 hours of elevated-burst completion. We will include the 4-hour guarantee in the addendum.
- Encryption & keying: all in-transit traffic to APAC uses TLS1.3; persistent artifacts are never stored in APAC long-term. Keys remain in your EU KMS if you choose customer-managed keys.

Operational bullets for the runbook (high level):
- Canary plan: ramp in APAC standby using canary routing (10% traffic) for first 48 hours after activation.
- Fallback: automated failback to EU tenancy when APAC latency < threshold for 24 hours.
- SLOs: standby pool will have a best-effort latency SLO; primary EU pool retains SLA.

Sending a Word-friendly addendum and a security summary bundle next.

— Monica
Monica Patel
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sana Qureshi <sana.qureshi@neurohealth.com>, Eliot Shaw <eliot@neurohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, legal@neurohealth.com
Date: 2026-11-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Draft addendum (Word) + pricing scenarios

Team —

Attached: Word copy of the addendum (redwood-residency-addendum-v1.pdf + .docx included in the bundle) and a pricing worksheet. Highlights:
- We added the 4-hour cache flush guarantee and an option to reduce EU log retention to 30 days.
- Standby pricing: monthly month-to-month vs 12-month reserved commit (15% discount on standby pool).
- Amendment clause: a simple two-paragraph clause specifying cross-region failover is activated only by your ops team or by preconfigured health hooks; any PII/PHI is handled per the EU residency rules.

Request: Can you confirm by Nov 24 whether you want the committed standby or M/M? If committed, we will draft the final SOW with the reserve and lock pricing in.

Thanks —
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-residency-addendum-v1.pdf, capacity-estimate-NeuroHealth-2026.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-summary.zip

Subject: Re: Draft addendum (Word) + pricing scenarios

Diego / team —

Quick update from our side: Legal has a couple of small redlines around the amendment clause (mostly tightening definitions of 'telemetry' and the approval workflow). Security is comfortable with the 4-hour flush and 30-day EU retention option.

We're leaning toward the 12-month committed standby (medium sizing) to give us predictable costs during the APAC pilot. Can you prepare the final SOW and a DocuSign package with the committed pricing and the two optional toggles (30-day retention / default 90-day)?

If you can get that over by Monday 11/22, we can route it through Legal and get a signature the same week.

— Eliot
Director, Platform Ops
NeuroHealth Inc
